verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an authentication library/framework for developers, not an AI agent or assistant with a runtime that consumes external MCP servers' tools. Its MCP-related features are about exposing itself as an MCP server/OAuth resource (docs-12, docs-59) or hosting a docs MCP server for other clients (docs-18, docs-32), not about the product itself plugging in and using tools from external MCP servers — so this client-side agenticness axis is a category error for this product.
